rationale: Admitted cold strict LR sources preserve GPU buckets and back omitted ERIs with pageable FP64 RAM by default. Automatic ceiling is min(32 GiB, one quarter of MemAvailable and cgroup-ancestor headroom); unknown capacity and optional allocation refusal retain exact Direct. Explicit zero disables. Full GPU residency, strict numerical gates, complete numeric admission and bounded device staging remain authoritative.
revisit_condition: Retain complete endpoint and work evidence when changing RAM reserve, bucket selection, source eligibility or staging. Initial 96/108-atom observations are not a universal crossover model. Temporary-disk backing and full-range consumers require separate qualification.
